catalyst_precursor.connectivity: Two Rh(I) centers bridged by both chloride ligands; two terminal C-bound carbonyls per Rh. The solution active species is to be investigated.

observed_product.name: Oxygen-tethered fused five/eight-membered lactone
observed_product.stereochemistry: One representative of the enantiomeric pair; relative geometry as depicted, no absolute enantioselection required.

conditions.experimental_context: Rh precursor under CO in mesitylene at 120 degC; oxygen-tethered substrate gives the carbonylative fused lactone (77% isolated). The broader family shows enhanced diene competition at low CO and sluggish conversion at excessive CO.
conditions.pressure_observation_qualification: The 0.2/1/4.4 atm pressure screen uses the N-tosyl tether analog in toluene at 110 degC; it is qualitative context, not a quantitative oxygen-substrate yield target.
conditions.family_observation_qualification: The reported failure of direct keto-(5+2) seven-membered ring formation is a family-level observation discussed with the N-tosyl substrate 1a experiments. The source does not provide an independent zero-yield or detection-limit measurement for this oxygen-tethered substrate. Its independently reported experiment gives the carbonylative lactone in 77% isolated yield.

net_product_boundaries.carbonylative_product: The fully specified observed_product is the fused five/eight-membered bicyclic lactone from substrate plus one CO (C10H14O3). The eight-membered ring contains the original ketone oxygen and the added carbonyl carbon.
net_product_boundaries.diene: Competing ring-opened connectivity CC(=O)COCC=CC=CC with unchanged C9H14O2 inventory. Diene formation is reported for the N-tosyl family analog; its competition for this oxygen-tethered substrate is a research question, not a separately measured oxygen-substrate yield. Distinguish alkene isomerism if claimed.

scope: Only the supplied oxygen-tethered substrate is scored. Family/pressure context is not permission to replace its atoms by NTs, phenyl, or an extended tether.
